summary: Virginia generally taxes clothing, footwear, accessories and protective or sport equipment at the state and applicable local and regional sales-tax rates.

citations.title: Code of Virginia §58.1-603
citations.quote: Of the gross sales price of each item or article of tangible personal property when sold at retail or distributed in this Commonwealth.

notes: Undated current statutory page uses 2017-08-03, the existing Virginia file’s date for this statute; no earlier source is asserted. Clothing is tangible personal property with no standing ordinary clothing exemption. Virginia’s temporary annual clothing sales-tax holiday is not modeled. The general base applies to state, local and regional sales taxes; no local clothing difference was found.

summary: All retail alcoholic beverages, whether packaged to take away or served in a bar or restaurant, are subject to Virginia general sales tax.

notes: Ruling publication date establishes earliest verification. The ruling expressly covers government liquor-store sales and drinks sold with or without food; its historical numeric tax rate is not carried forward. State and local sales taxes follow the general retail base. Alcohol excise taxes and any separate local meals taxes are not included.
